sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美西语近岸软件研发外包与数字客服中心

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Social Commerce via Short Video Platforms

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law 1258 of 2008 (S.A.S. framework); Law 526 of 1999 (creation of the Financial Information and Analysis Unit – UIAF); Law 1121 of 2006 (AML/CTF prevention); Law 1762 of 2015 (offshore corruption and money laundering); Decree 830 of 2021 (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales – RUBF); DIAN Resolution 00164 of 2023 (RUBF implementation and UBO reporting calendars); Circular Externa 011 of 2018 of the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (sectoral AML regime for non-regulated commercial sectors).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Incorporation Instrument (Documento Privado de Constitución de S.A.S.) with authenticated signatures of all founding shareholders
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notaría Pública (Colombian Notary) with subsequent filing at the Cámara de Comercio
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization (autenticación de firmas) plus Chamber of Commerce electronic registration

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Foreign Shareholder Identity Documents (passport copy) and, if applicable, Certificate of Incorporation and Good Standing of the corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent corporate registry or passport authority of the shareholder's home jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney (Poder General) granted by foreign shareholders to the incorporation agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign notary / public authority of shareholder's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille plus Spanish translation by a certified Colombian translator

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Judicial Records Certificate (Certificado de Antecedentes Judiciales) of the legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Domestic administrative issuance via the national online portal (no apostille required for domestic use)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Tax Residency Certificate of foreign corporate shareholder (for post-incorporation treaty benefit claims)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Tax authority of the shareholder's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille plus Spanish translation (when applicable)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all legal representatives, officers, founding shareholders, and every UBO holding 5% or more of shares or voting rights against: (i) OFAC SDN and sectoral sanctions lists (Lista Clinton); (ii) UN Security Council Consolidated List; (iii) EU consolidated financial sanctions list; (iv) Colombian national risk alerts (Listas de Riesgo UIAF/DIAN) and the PEP registry maintained per Circular Externa 011/2018; (v) criminal records verification via the Policía Nacional. Any positive hit triggers immediate suspension of the incorporation process, enhanced due diligence, and mandatory Suspicious Transaction Report (ROS) filing to the UIAF where applicable.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Ventanilla Única Empresarial (VUE) / Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) — operated through the competent Cámara de Comercio (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá at www.rue.org.co or www.ccb.org.co)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be expressed in Latin script. Spanish is the standard statutory language, but foreign terms are admissible if transliterated accurately into Latin characters for the Mercantile Registry. The legal name must end with the suffix 'S.A.S.' or 'SAS'. The chosen denomination must not be identical or phonetically similar to an existing registered enterprise name (principle of homonimia), and descriptive tokens must reflect the actual business activity for e-commerce retail.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the name clearance (certificado de homonimia) is rejected, the applicant may file a 'recurso de reposición' before the same Cámara de Comercio within 10 business days, and subsequently a 'recurso de apelación' before the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) within 5 business days. Alternatively, the applicant may immediately reserve a new name via the RUES portal. Name reservations are non-transferable, expire after 30 days, and no formal extension is generally available; a new reservation request must be filed.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Partially permissible. A virtual office or co-working workspace address may be registered if the service provider physically operates in Colombia and undertakes to accept, store, and forward legal notifications and commercial correspondence. No physical retail storefront is required for ISIC 4791 online-only commerce, but a verifiable Colombian postal address (dirección de notificación judicial) and a local authorized representative are mandatory for the SAS to maintain valid commercial substance.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate risk for pure e-commerce merchants: approximately 5–10% probability of an unannounced physical inspection by DIAN or the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio within the first twelve months of operation. Risk increases to approximately 20% if invoicing irregularities, tax incentive claims, or inventory discrepancies are flagged in the pre-incorporation compliance review.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio competente (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff set by Confecámaras (approx. COP 28,000 – 40,000)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of signatories' identities and authentication of signatures on the incorporation instrument
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notarial tariff (Arancel Notarial) published by the Superintendencia de Notariado y Registro

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Mercantile Registry Filing Fee at the Cámara de Comercio (derechos de inscripción)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registration tariff (approx. COP 74,000 base fee) applicable to assets below the minimum taxable threshold

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Departamento / Secretaría de Hacienda of the registration district
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Departmental ordinance setting a rate between 0.3% and 0.7% of subscribed capital; calculated here on minimum capital

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal drafting and due diligence of incorporation instrument, by-laws, and shareholder resolutions (minuta y estatutos)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for pre-incorporation drafting in Bogotá / Medellín (flat fee)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille and certified Spanish translation of foreign shareholder documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Foreign competent authority (apostille office) plus certified Colombian translator
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Hague Apostille convention tariff (varies by foreign jurisdiction) plus prevailing market translation fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: RUBF UBO initial registration filing and compliance letter (Decree 830/2021, DIAN Resolution 164/2023)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: DIAN (via registered filing agent or compliance advisor)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No statutory fee; prevailing compliance-advisory benchmark for UBO data preparation and filing

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP / Sanctions screening report of shareholders, UBOs, and legal representatives (OFAC, UNSC, EU, Colombian lists)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: AML compliance technology provider or external compliance counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark per screened individual (flat fee per corporate onboarding package)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (S.A.S. regime, arts. 1, 4, 5, 17-19, 30); Codigo de Comercio (Decreto 410 de 1971, arts. 110, 116, 353-372); Decreto 1074 de 2015 (Registro Mercantil and Registro Unico Empresarial); Decreto 2100 de 2019 (DIAN RUT regime)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Camara de Comercio del domicilio social (e.g., Camara de Comercio de Bogota), operating the Registro Unico Empresarial (RUE) and the Registro Mercantil, integrated with DIAN and RUES
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitucion de la Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada (private incorporation deed executed before a notary for signature authentication and registered with the Registro Mercantil)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; capital amount is freely fixed in the bylaws. If the bylaws are silent on payment terms, the full subscribed capital must be paid within two years of incorporation (Ley 1258/2008, art. 30). No escrow account requirement applies to this social-commerce retail activity; capital may be contributed in kind.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION — [COMPANY NAME] S.A.S. The founders and directors, acting under Ley 1258 de 2008 and the bylaws, unanimously resolve: 1. Ratify the subscription and initial payment of share capital as stated in the incorporation deed, confirming the share allocation to each founding shareholder. 2. Adopt the registered office at [address], Bogota D.C., Colombia, as the legal domicile for all statutory, fiscal, and judicial notices. 3. Appoint [Name] as sole Legal Representative and [Name] as alternate, granting full and sufficient powers to execute contracts, open bank accounts, and complete regulatory filings before DIAN and the Chamber of Commerce. 4. Instruct the Legal Representative to register the company as an employer with the social security system and to execute the TikTok Shop seller agreement and payment-rail contracts. Adopted unanimously on [date].

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Unico Empresarial (RUES) online portal administered by the local Camara de Comercio (e.g., Camara de Comercio de Bogota)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log into the RUES homonimia module and submit a search with three alternative corporate names. Obtain the digital Certificado de Homonimia validating availability and retain it for the incorporation filing. The certificate is valid for 30 calendar days.
required_dossiers: Completed RUES homonimia online request form
Copy of the applicant's national identification document (cedula) or passport
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected as identical, confusingly similar, or contrary to public order, resubmit the request with alternative names and obtain a new certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and notarial authentication of the private incorporation document
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public of the founders' choice, followed by the local Camara de Comercio for registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Documento Privado de Constitucion under Ley 1258/2008 covering bylaws, subscribed capital, corporate purpose (including social commerce and online retail under ISIC 4791), directors, legal representative, and domicile. All founders must sign every page, and the signatures of the founders and the legal representative must be authenticated by a notary.
required_dossiers: Draft bylaws (estatutos) signed by all founding shareholders
Identification documents (cedula or passport) of each founder
Valid Certificado de Homonimia
Proof of initial capital payment or in-kind contribution valuation, if any
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary raises objections to the corporate purpose or bylaws, amend the deed and resubmit; minor omissions may be corrected by a clarifying addendum (aclaracion) before registry filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing for registration in the Registro Mercantil (S.A.S. merchant sub-registry)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Camara de Comercio with territorial jurisdiction over the registered office (Registro Mercantil)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the authenticated Documento Privado de Constitucion together with the digital Formulario de Registro Unico Empresarial through the chamber's virtual office. Pay the mercantile registration tariff calculated on subscribed capital (minimum tariff approximately COP 34,000) and collect the Certificado de Existencia y Representacion Legal upon approval.
required_dossiers: Authenticated Documento Privado de Constitucion
Formulario de Registro Unico Empresarial (digital)
Certificado de Homonimia
Payment receipt of the registration tariff
RUT or NIT pre-registration data, if obtained in advance
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the chamber issues a subsanacion requirement, correct the specific omissions or inconsistencies listed within the stated term (generally five business days) and refile using the same case number.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax identification (RUT/NIT) and electronic invoicing setup with DIAN
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Direccion de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the tax pre-registration through the chamber's integration with the Registro Unico Tributario to obtain the NIT. Access the DIAN MUISCA portal to set the income-tax classification, withholding responsibilities, and the mandatory electronic invoicing (factura electronica) obligation for sales through TikTok Shop. Authorize an electronic billing software operator (operador de facturacion) if required.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representacion Legal (issued within the last 30 days)
Identification document of the legal representative
Email address and password for the DIAN account
Formulario RUT pre-registration data
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN rejects the RUT application for inconsistencies, correct the registration data in the MUISCA portal and resubmit; requests may also be resolved in person at the DIAN formalization window (ventanilla de formalizacion).

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Mandatory employer and social security registration (ARL/EPS/Caja de Compensacion/Pension)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Social security administrators via the unified payroll plan (Planilla Integrada de Liquidacion de Aportes - PILA) and the local Caja de Compensacion Familiar
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Before hiring any employee, register the company as an employer with an ARL (labor risk insurer), a pension administrator, an EPS (health entity), and the Caja de Compensacion Familiar of the domicile territory. Register the company in the PILA system and declare the workplace address for risk-classification purposes.
required_dossiers: NIT of the company
Certificado de Existencia y Representacion Legal
Identification document of the legal representative
Workplace address and SGSST self-diagnosis form under Resolucion 0312 de 2019
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If an administrator rejects employer affiliation due to incomplete SGSST documentation, complete the SGSST auto-diagnosis and re-submit through the online platform; re-registration is usually confirmed instantly.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate bank account opening and payment-rail onboarding for TikTok Shop and Wise
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Colombian financial institution (e.g., Bancolombia, Davivienda) and the TikTok Shop seller compliance review
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate bank account in the name of the S.A.S. using the certificate of existence, NIT, and legal representative documents. Complete TikTok Shop seller verification with business documents, VAT data, and bank payout details; link the corporate account or a Wise B2B account as the payout destination for sales proceeds.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representacion Legal (original, less than 30 days old)
RUT/NIT of the company
Passport of the legal representative
Completed AML (UIA/beneficial owner) bank questionnaire
TikTok Shop business verification documents (incorporation certificate, bank statement, tax record)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank or TikTok Shop rejects the documentation, correct the beneficial-owner declaration, provide updated notarized company records, or change the authorized representative and resubmit through the institution's compliance appeal channel.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Comercio, Industria y Turismo (MINCIT) for sectorial supervision; local Secretaria Distrital/Municipal de Planeacion for the optional land-use certificate (uso de suelo) applicable to any physical warehouse or storage premises
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No national operating license is required for ISIC 4791 retail trade conducted through digital platforms; the mandatory baseline is the Registro Unico Empresarial (RUE) with the Camara de Comercio, supplemented by a voluntary Certificado de Uso del Suelo if physical premises are used

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) and the territorial Corporaciones Autonomas Regionales (CAR)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from the full EIA licensing procedure: the activity is not listed under Decreto 1076 de 2015, article 2.2.2.3.2.3 (Annex II). Only a generic environmental compliance posture and the management of solid/package waste through licensed waste operators are required for digital-retail operations.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Where physical premises exist, non-domestic wastewater discharge must comply with Resolucion 0631 de 2015 (pH 6.0-9.0, TSS < 80 mg/L, BOD5 < 70 mg/L, COD < 150 mg/L); packaging and recyclable waste must be routed through certified gestores de residuos under Resolucion 1407 de 2018; VOC emissions are negligible and no specific threshold applies for warehouse or digital-only retail activity.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate (Concepto Tecnico or Certificado del Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos) for any physical storage or office facility; structural load and workplace safety inspections as required by local planeacion authorities; implementation of the SGSST (Sistema de Gestion de Seguridad y Salud en el Trabajo) per Resolucion 0312 de 2019 and ARL labor-risk clearance before commencement of operations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) — National Tax and Customs Directorate of Colombia; operational portal: www.dian.gov.co and MUISCA (Modelo Único de Ingresos, Servicios y Control Automatizado) for RUT/NIT, e-invoicing, and customs export declarations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: (1) Incorporate the S.A.S. by private document or notarial deed and register it with the Mercantile Registry of the competent Cámara de Comercio; foreign shareholder documents and powers of attorney must be apostilled and translated into Spanish. (2) Appoint a legal representative domiciled in Colombia and grant a special power for tax registration. (3) File the pre-RUT via DIAN's MUISCA portal and obtain the NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria); for an S.A.S. submitted digitally, the NIT is issued upon RUT validation, typically the same day. (4) In the RUT, the entity must be marked as 'Responsable del IVA Régimen Común', with CIIU activity 4791 (retail sale via internet and social platforms), the exporter status for outbound e-commerce, and the municipal ICA registration where applicable. (5) Obtain a DIAN-enabled electronic signature certificate (e.g., Certicámara or GSE) and request the e-invoicing 'Resolución de Habilitación de Facturación' in MUISCA to activate electronic billing. Lead time: 3–10 business days for full enablement; NIT issuance can be same-day for a digital RUT filing.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — the Colombian-resident S.A.S. is a separate taxable entity subject to corporate income tax at the general rate of 35% on worldwide income. No pass-through or check-the-box classification is available. Dividends paid to non-resident shareholders carry additional dividend withholding surcharge. Territorial_Scope is residence-based for CIT, while non-resident shareholders remain taxable only on Colombian-source items. Tax_Exempt_Zone status is not available to a standard S.A.S., but free-trade-zone certification requires separate DIAN/zoning qualification.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election exists in Colombian law; anti-hybrid rules from Law 2010/2019 apply mandatorily. Available elections include: (i) 'Régimen SIMPLE de Tributación', an elective aggregate levy combining income tax, VAT, national consumption tax, and municipal ICA for taxpayers with prior-year gross income not exceeding 80,000 UVT (approximately COP 3.98 billion for 2025), subject to activity limits and owner eligibility; (ii) the new-company CIT progression under Law 2069/2020 (Art. 100 E.T.) for newly incorporated small SAS entities with gross income capped at 45,000 UVT, phasing in the 35% tariff through reduced rates in the first four tax years and full tariff from year five onward; (iii) voluntary election of the VAT exclusion treatment for export of services under Decree 2150/2017 and Article 481 E.T.; (iv) for transfer-pricing purposes only, the designation of a group-wide 'Grupo Empresarial' regime; Colombia does not allow consolidated income tax filing.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA — Impuesto sobre las Ventas (Colombian Value Added Tax on goods, services, and digital commerce)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: COP 0 — there is no monetary VAT registration threshold for a corporate S.A.S. seller; registration in the RUT as a 'Responsable del Régimen Común' is mandatory from the first taxable act (sale) executed in Colombia. The simplified-regime threshold of 3,500 UVT applies exclusively to natural persons and is unavailable to corporations. For non-resident foreign digital-commerce providers, Law 2010/2019 requires IVA registration with no turnover threshold if services are used in Colombia; a foreign marketplace platform (e.g., TikTok Shop acting as intermediary) has the same no-threshold nexus rule.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time e-invoicing applies to all IVA taxpayers. The S.A.S. must (i) hold the DIAN 'Resolución de Habilitación de Facturación Electrónica'; (ii) issue each sales invoice in the DIAN-standardized UBL/XML format; (iii) transmit the document to DIAN's MUISCA web-services API prior to delivery; (iv) receive the validation/accreditation response and embed the CUFE (Código Único de Facturación Electrónica) and DIAN QR code; and (v) preserve the signed XML for the statutory 10-year period. DIAN performs near-real-time validation against the RUT and VAT patterns. TikTok Shop payout reports do not substitute for the DIAN electronic invoice, and all social-commerce sales must flow through the e-invoice pipeline.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods physically departing Colombian customs territory are excluded from IVA at 0% under Article 481 E.T. For an S.A.S. engaged in social-commerce retail (ISIC 4791), eligibility requires: (i) a customs export declaration accepted by DIAN; (ii) physical dispatch of the goods abroad within the fiscal period; (iii) the foreign buyer as principal in the transaction; and (iv) receipt of payment via the authorized foreign-exchange market. Digital and platform-related services (marketing, advertising, marketplace fees) supplied to non-domiciled clients qualify as export of services when the benefit is wholly used outside Colombia and the recipient has no Colombian domicile. Both categories generate refundable input VAT balances where creditable IVA exceeds output IVA.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Declaración de Exportación (DEX / vDEX) — the DIAN-accepted electronic customs export declaration constituting legal evidence of the shipment
Bill of Lading / Air Waybill / multimodal transport document evidencing effective removal of the goods from Colombian national customs territory, issued by the carrier
Certificado de Reintegro de Divisas (Inward Remittance Certificate) issued by a Colombian authorized foreign-exchange intermediary proving crediting of the export proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN reconciles the DEX, e-invoice, transport documents, and foreign-exchange settlement records in targeted exporter audits. If a 0% rating is invalidated, the export is reclassified as a domestic taxable transaction, giving rise to a 19% VAT assessment on the invoice price plus daily default interest (Art. 634 E.T.), the inexactness penalty of 100% of the omitted tax (160% where the export is simulated, nonexistent, or fraudulently documented under Art. 648 E.T.), retroactive recovery of any input-VAT refunds, and collection surcharges. Serious cases trigger criminal liability for customs fraud and smuggling under Law 1762/2015. Failure to repatriate export FX within the 180-day deadline subjects the exporter to exchange-regime fines of up to 2,000 monthly minimum statutory wages and adjustments, in addition to the tax clawback.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (BanRep), operating as the central bank and foreign exchange authority through the Comisión de Cambios, with enforcement by the Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) and the Unidad de Información y Análisis Financiero (UIAF). Regulatory basis comprises Law 9 of 1991, Decree 1068 of 2015, Decree 2555 of 2010, and Banco de la República Resolution 8 of 2000.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia operates a free-floating convertible currency regime for current-account transactions and for most capital-account transactions routed through the Official Foreign Exchange Market (MCR, Mercado Cambiario Regulador) via authorized intermediaries (CAMs). Profit remittance in the form of dividends and branch profits is convertible without exchange-rationing restrictions once the foreign investment has been registered on Form No. 1 (Registro de Inversiones Internacionales) with BanRep, and once the distribution has been approved in accordance with the Company by-laws and Colombian commercial law. Remittance obstacles are primarily documentary: promoter financial statements, proof of corporate income tax on distributable earnings, payment evidence of any statutory withholding, and a completed exchange declaration filed by the local bank. Capital inflows require lawful channeling and registration; repatriation is conditional on full registration. Unregistered capital inflows are not entitled to future access to the MCR for exit, and may be deemed illegal possession of foreign exchange.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under Resolution 8 of 2000 and subsequent amendments, export proceeds for goods must be channeled through a CAM within six months from the date of the export customs dispatch. For services, the channeling period is generally the contractual payment term subject to a maximum of five months after the service is completed or the agreed payment maturity date, unless an extension is authorized by BanRep. There is no mandatory conversion ratio to Colombian pesos; the exporter is required to bring the proceeds into the country through an authorized intermediary and may retain foreign currency in a local external-circulation account. The exporter must submit an exchange declaration (Form No. 4 for goods, Form No. 5 for services and other concepts) documenting the repatriation. Failure to channel proceeds within the statutory term can trigger fines, presumptions of illegal exchange operations, and cross-reporting to the UIAF.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account - corriente; Foreign Currency Savings Account (dólares)
Operational Account - corriente; Foreign Currency Account
Operational Account - corriente; Foreign Currency Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria Colombia S.A. (BBVA)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility is Low-Medium as a principal treasury rail and Medium as an ancillary collection/payment gateway. Offshore Digital EMI institutions such as Wise, Payoneer, and Mercury are not licensed by the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia to conduct deposit-taking or payment-account services for Colombian residents. They cannot satisfy the mandatory channeling requirement for foreign-exchange settlement, which requires a local CAM. A foreign EMI may be used as a non-Colombian payment collector to compress settlement timing on TikTok Shop payouts, but the underlying sales proceeds must be repatriated in original currency to the Colombian S.A.S. bank account with a CAM. The contractual and documentary structure must show the EMI as a mere billing/collection processor, not as the official account of the Colombian entity.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In practice, tier-1 Colombian banks mandate at least one in-person onboarding meeting for a newly incorporated foreign-owned S.A.S. A physical appearance by the legal representative or by a local apoderado holding a special power of attorney is required for execution of account documentation, biometric verification, and compliance certification. Fully remote opening is accepted only for already operating, low-risk Colombian companies with established credit history, proven local directorate, and no non-resident UBO concentration. For the TikTok Shop retail structure, remote-only opening is not considered viable; one director or a local representative should travel or hold a local Colombian identity card.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Newly incorporated S.A.S. with no financial statements, no local operating history, and non-resident shareholders, created solely to manage TikTok Shop retail proceeds.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Cámara de Comercio certificate of incorporation and good standing not older than 30 days; updated RUT tax registry; notarized articles of incorporation with ISIC 4791 scope; shareholder registry and UBO declaration; passport copies of shareholders; board resolution appointing the legal representative; sworn source-of-funds and source-of-wealth questionnaire; corporate structure chart; AML compliance manual; and signed written commitment to comply with Law 1121/2006 and Circular 004/2017.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High frequency of inbound cross-border wire transfers from foreign payment processors (TikTok, Wise, Payoneer, Stripe) with modest ticket values and ambiguous commercial invoices.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed marketplace agreement with TikTok or its local payment gateway; seller portal payout statements; transaction-level reports and reconciliation files; purchase invoices for inventory; shipping and delivery evidence with courier tracking; returns and chargeback logs; tax clearance certificate; and a bank-format funds-flow explanation indicating that all cross-border receipts relate to actual retail sales.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Concentration of treasury flows through foreign fintech/EMI accounts, creating a risk that the Colombian entity is operating as an unauthorized payment intermediary.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Licensing/legal opinion on the EMI's home-country regulatory status; service agreement describing the EMI as a non-deposit payment processor; records showing that the EMI acts as a pass-through account only with zero end-of-day balance; UBO/KYC dossier for the EMI account; a commitment that the Colombian local bank will serve as the sole funding and cash-concentration anchor; and signed declarations confirming no solicitation of Colombian residents for the EMI account.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Discrepancy between reported taxable revenue to DIAN and gross cash inflows into Colombia, with substantial intercompany transfers from the foreign shareholder.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Monthly tax reconciliations (ICA, VAT, withholdings); intercompany loan or capital contribution agreements with interest-rate computation; Colombian transfer-pricing documentation and Form 115/120 filing evidence; incoming MT103 messages with reference numbers; board minutes approving every treasury operation; periodic statutory financial statements prepared by a Colombian CPA; and independent external audit report on income recognition.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Multiple UBOs residing in high-risk jurisdictions or in jurisdictions with differing AML standards, combined with complex share transfers.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Please provide full beneficiaries chart; passport copies; legal entity search certificates from the shareholder's registry; notarized affidavits explaining the source of each shareholder contribution; international criminal/background check reports where legally accessible; and a board-approved policy requiring automatic UBO review on any change of ownership.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: For a capital injection from the foreign shareholder, the structured protocol is a SWIFT MT103 wire from the investor's bank to the Colombian S.A.S. bank account at a CAM. The receiving bank must be instructed via the payment narrative to document the transfer as inbound direct investment and to complete the exchange declaration Form No. 1 (Inversión Internacional), citing the specific subcode for foreign direct investment in a non-financial company. The investor must provide the bank with a letter of instructions, the corporate resolution approving the capital increase, a copy of the shareholder registry and NIT certificate, and, where the contribution exceeds a high threshold, proof of the source of funds and a certificate of non-involvement in tax havens. After the wire is cleared, the S.A.S. must file the Registro de Inversiones Internacionales with BanRep through the CAM within the statutory registration window (recommended within 30 days; legally required before repatriation). The bank will record the COP exchange transaction using the TRM (market reference rate) of the day.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Payments to overseas suppliers, third-party fulfilment centers, and platform advertising vendors must be made through the local CAM to preserve FX legality. For standard low-value, high-frequency trade settlements, an MT103 customer transfer initiated via the local bank's electronic treasury module with full invoice reference is appropriate. For large wholesale purchases from Asian apparel or electronics suppliers, an irrevocable documentary letter of credit (sight or deferred payment) issued by the Colombian bank is recommended, supported by the import declaration. Each outgoing payment requires a corresponding exchange declaration: Form No. 3 for importation of goods and Form No. 5 for services and other transfers. The CAM will maintain a sub-ledger that ties the outbound foreign-currency payment to the import declaration and to the Colombian company's invoicing sequence.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable Colombian peso / U.S. dollar forward contracts (FX forwards) traded with a licensed local CAM under the Official Foreign Exchange Market.
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing the peso/dollar TRM, settled net in pesos or dollars, subject to the existence of an underlying commercial exposure.
Cross-currency interest rate swaps (cross-currency swaps, CCIRS) used to hedge long-term balance-sheet exposure on foreign-currency debt or investments.
Plain-vanilla over-the-counter foreign exchange options (COP-USD calls and puts), entered into only with an authorized Colombian financial institution and designed for hedging, not speculation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil (Annual Commercial Registry Renewal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 March each year for entities registered as merchants on the preceding 31 December.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal is registered as extemporánea and incurs a surcharge; prolonged non-renewal triggers cancellation of the mercantile registration and strike-off. The Superintendencia de Sociedades may also impose fines for failure to comply with annual information obligations.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Estados Financieros de Fin de Ejercicio (annual financial statements for the preceding fiscal year, including statements of financial position, performance, changes in equity, and cash flows)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social; if under Superintendencia de Sociedades supervision, also filed in the SISNE system.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within three (3) months following the fiscal year-end (by 31 March for a 31 December fiscal year), and in any event within fifteen (15) days after approval by the shareholders' meeting.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file blocks the renewal of the mercantile registration, may expose the legal representative to fines, and may lead to enforcement by the Superintendencia de Sociedades.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración Nacional del Impuesto sobre la Renta y Complementarios (annual corporate income tax return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) via MUISCA
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed annually for the preceding tax year during the DIAN calendar group; for most corporate taxpayers the window runs from early September to mid-October based on the last two digits of the NIT.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty and default interest under the Estatuto Tributario; non-filing can trigger an official assessment and monetary sanctions under Articles 631 and 641 E.T.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Actualización anual del Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales (RUBF) (annual update of the ultimate beneficial owner register)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually in the calendar period fixed by DIAN Resolution, aligned with the tax calendar and the commercial registry renewal; generally the update must be performed within one month after the renewal of the matrícula mercantil.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to submit or update the RUBF is subject to monetary fines (up to 30,000 UVT per infraction) and may impair successful renewal and issuance of certificates.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Acta de la Asamblea Anual de Accionistas (annual shareholders' meeting minutes approving the financial statements and corporate results)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Not externally filed; recorded in the company's official minutes book and retained at the registered office; available for inspection by the tax authority or the Superintendencia de Sociedades when requested.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: The meeting must be convened and held by 31 March following the fiscal year-end.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Absence of corporate records and the failure to hold the annual meeting constitutes a books-and-records compliance violation, potentially generating fines and evidentiary prejudice in any relevant proceeding.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A Colombian SAS must appoint a statutory auditor (revisor fiscal) if, as of the preceding 31 December, (a) gross income or total assets exceed 3,000 SMLMV (approx. COP 4.27 billion in 2025); (b) it has more than 15 employees; or (c) shareholders holding at least 20% of shares request a revisor fiscal. Otherwise, audit is only voluntarily adopted.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Technical accounting standards under Law 1314 of 2009 and Decree 2420 of 2015. A closed SAS engaged in TikTok social commerce is normally classified as Grupo 2 and must apply the 'Normas de Información Financiera para Pymes' (IFRS for SMEs), including accounting policies for revenue recognition under Section 23, financial instruments, and related-party disclosures.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Share transfers must be recorded in the company's register of shareholders; if effected through a notarial deed or private document, the document must be delivered to the Cámara de Comercio for notation. The annual RUBF update to DIAN constitutes the annual confirmation of beneficial ownership; for every change in shareholding or economic rights during the year, the entity must update the RUBF information within the calendar month following the change, and in the annual confirmation the company must reaffirm the full identity and percentage of every ultimate beneficial owner.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 100–250 per year for a registered office/virtual office in a major Colombian chamber jurisdiction
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not mandatory below the revisor fiscal thresholds; if voluntarily or statutorily required, a certified audit typically ranges from USD 3,500 to USD 10,000 per year.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 35% for taxable years 2024-2025 (Ley 2277/2022); surtax for financial sector not applicable to e-commerce
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Deductions: 50% of technology/innovation investments (Art. 158-2 ET), 130% deduction for payroll of employees under 28 (Art. 108-5 ET), 30% ICT investment deduction; no general tax holiday; 'Régimen Simple' optional up to 100,000 UVT gross income
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Indefinite (no statutory time limit; annual use capped at 25% of net income - Law 1819/2016)
